158	## Summary
159	
160	S4 splits into 10 iterations across three layers of the DAG: foundational helpers (git_ops.branch_exists_on_origin, feature_sync resolution and state-transition cases, feature_hooks.enqueue stub) in the first layer; worker wiring (_run_one branch + _run_feature_decompose method) and the decomposition skill in the middle layer; and integration tests (_finalize + tasks.py reply path + end-to-end) in the final layer. The DAG is intentionally wide so multiple implementors can run in parallel — I1, I2, I5, I9 have no deps.
